name: desktop-responsive-catalog-review
goal: Readable project and revision choices, distinct composer states and complete level text at every viewport

evidence: Notes 11-16 require readable picker context, distinct composer states and unclipped level text at desktop, tablet and mobile.

Existing component-catalog-previews cases checked option presence, text retention and mode values. They omitted trigger context, painted icons, useful empty labels, failed-send feedback, a visual-plan cue and textarea content height. Extend the same state cases without increasing their count.
